details: Eacq-acq-menu-core@35.9.7 is a multi-stage binary dropper. On require, index.js loads _helpers.js, which fingerprints the platform/arch and downloads a platform-specific payload from Cloudflare Workers endpoints (oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf103-070[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf99-9b3[.]workers[.]dev, paths /pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe). If HTTPS download fails it falls back to a DNS-TXT base64 channel under *.dl[.]wel1[.]ru (c[.]sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru). The fetched binary is written to /tmp/.cache_<hex> (or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe in TEMP on Windows), chmod 755, and executed detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c start /b, so it outlives the parent process. A stamp file (.analytics_state / analytics_state) throttles re-downloads.
